newsitem.title: UK: GMAC appoints head of European operations.
newsitem.headline: GMAC appoints head of European operations.

text.p: General Motors Acceptance Corp, the financing arm of General Motors, said it named Rudi Doerr as group vice president in charge of European operations.
Doerr, 53, assumes responsibility for GMAC units in 17 countries in Europe and will lead the company's European strategy board, the company said in a statement.

Doerr, who was vice president in charge of GMAC operations in Germany, Austria, Hungary, Norway, Poland and Switzerland since March 1995, succeeds Dieter Nicodemus, who is on medical leave, GMAC said.
Doerr will retain his position as managing director of Opel Bank, GMAC's biggest unit outside North America, headquartered in Germany.
